items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: There’s Maraca Valle, “Land of Maraca Valle,” a Cuban flautist, I’m writing lyrics to his tune and I’m going to record that.

ctx.x: To get to the solo. I concur. What’s coming up in the near future for you?

Well I just got together with Toninho Horta just before I came up here and we’re planning a duet album and we are putting that together right now. And then I have, again it’s been a year since the last album came out so I’ve been compiling material. I have some sessions planned but not specifically dated. And I’m going to do the material that I’ve been accumulating. There’s Maraca Valle, “Land of Maraca Valle,” a Cuban flautist, I’m writing lyrics to his tune and I’m going to record that. Actually the lyrics are…
They come and they go. I got one for you tonight.
